title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Time, Speed and Distance (Trains)
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A train, 1312 m long, is running at a speed of 54 m/s. If it takes 106 seconds to cross a tunnel, then find the length of the tunnel.
questions.explain:
Let the length of the tunnel be $x$ meters.
Total distance to cross the tunnel $= \text{Length of train} + \text{Length of tunnel} = (1312 + x)$ m.
$\text{Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$
$1312 + x = 54 \times 106$
$1312 + x = 5724$
$x = 5724 - 1312 = 4412 \text{ m}$.
